visualCharacteristics: One or more promotional panels shown side by side over a shared background; each panel pairs media (image or video) with a content column (eyebrow, heading, description, one or more CTA links).
contentPattern: One row per panel: media (image or video) + content cell (eyebrow, heading, description, CTA link(s)).
usage: 'Design Service' / 'Happiness in Every Moment' dual promo band on the homepage.
